verdict.rationale: Xero's reconciliation page says you can connect bank accounts to Xero and have JAX categorize and match the imported transactions. The App Store lists a Mercury bank connection. However, nothing in the pack documents credit-card account feeds or an automatic daily import schedule. Missing for 10: evidence of credit-card account connections, documentation that transactions import automatically on a recurring daily basis, independent or hands-on corroboration of bank feed reliability.

support.subject: As a founder, I can connect bank and credit-card accounts so transactions import automatically every day

citations.quote: Connect your bank accounts to Xero. Let JAX categorize and match transactions while you're busy with your real work.
